name: signal-noise
author: Claude
description: Value noise sampled over time drives emissive brightness. Noise is signed (~-0.5..0.5), so it is biased to 0..1 before use or it would clip to black half the time. Tests: noise generation.

noiseValue.note: Value noise, varies with time; ranges roughly -0.5..0.5.

noiseVis.note: Centred at 0.5 so the flicker stays visible instead of clamping to 0.

outputs.note: Grey emissive that flickers with the biased noise.
